need to determine crimes based on facts: selling counterfeit currency (10,000 yuan total face value) for 12,000 yuan. That's counterfeit currency trafficking. Under Chinese criminal law, crimes: "伪造、变造货币罪" (counterfeiting currency) or "买卖假币罪" (selling counterfeit money). The specific offense is "买卖假币罪" (selling counterfeit currency). Also possibly "非法买卖货币罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 176 of Criminal Law: "伪造、变造货币罪" includes manufacturing, smuggling, buying, selling, possessing counterfeit currency. So the act of selling counterfeit money is "买卖假币罪" which is part of "伪造、变造货币罪". The appropriate charge: "买卖假币罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪"? No. The fact includes that he returned 12,000 yuan to investigation (退赃). That may be considered restitution, not a separate crime.

Thus only one crime: "买卖假币罪". In Chinese legal terms, the formal name is "买卖假币罪". Could also be "伪造、变造货币罪". Usually the charge is "买卖假币罪". We'll output that.

Format: [罪名]买卖假币罪<eoa>
